messages:
Maria: Heads-up — posted a quick mock of the invite entrypoint. Goal: make accepting invites + SSO onboarding obvious without stealing screen real-estate. Screenshot in thread. cc @Devon @Ashley :mag_right:

Devon: Nice. Two quick notes — 1) the role cards feel dense; can we collapse permissions to a hover/expand? 2) the SSO banner looks like a system alert (red) — maybe a softer tone.

Ashley: a11y nit: CTA contrast is borderline when the banner is on top of gradient. Needs 4.5:1. Also keyboard focus on the role chips isn't visible.

Kevin: re: contrast, proposed CSS snippet:
`````
.btn-primary { background: var(--green-600); color: #071013; }
.sso-banner { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f4fbf7, #ffffff); }
`````
Works in the mock; can run through theme tokens.

Samira: Audit log navigation thought — if we add a small 'audit trail' link on the invite card (eye icon) it saves a click. But we need to avoid visual noise. Maybe a subtle kebab menu with 'view audit'?

Maria: Agree with kebab + icon. Also thinking of an optional compact mode for orgs with many roles — toggled via a compact switch in settings.

Devon: Compact mode is fine but keep discoverability — maybe a toast that says 'Compact mode hides permission details — press ? to expand' :thinking_face:

Ashley: keyboard walkthrough: tab order currently goes: role card -> invite CTA -> sso toggle -> modal close. Suggest moving sso toggle earlier right after role cards so screen reader users hear context.

Kevin: FYI the runtime team flagged that long role lists will push token counts on the console snapshots — we should paginate or lazy-load.

Maria: Good call. Action items:
- Devon: explore collapsed-permissions hover pattern + microcopy for 'what's hidden'
- Ashley: run contrast + keyboard flow tests, file a11y issues
- Kevin: share CSS tokens and check lazy-load placeholder pattern
- Samira: mock audit-kebab + microinteraction
I'll drop updated Figma by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

design-bot: Accessibility scan results (quick): 2 fails (CTA contrast, focus outline). Suggested severity: medium. Link: https://redwood.design/scan/2119876543

Devon: Thanks — will sync after you post Figma. 👍
